description: This file defines an abstract base class 'BaseRerankConfig' that specifies the interface for reranking configuration implementations in a machine learning or NLP project. It includes abstract methods for environment validation, request and response transformation, URL construction, parameter mapping, error handling, and cost calculation related to reranking models.

classes.description: Abstract base class defining the interface for rerank configuration classes.
